Extract selected POD5 signal vectors

Source: R/read_pod5.R
extract_pod5_signal.Rd

This is a convenience wrapper around read_pod5 that requests signal data and returns only the signal component of the result. Signals can be returned either as raw ADC counts or as calibrated current values.

Usage

extract_pod5_signal(
  file,
  read_ids = NULL,
  calibrated = FALSE,
  start_sample = 1,
  end_sample = Inf
)

Arguments

file

character or external pointer: POD5 path or open native reader

read_ids

character (default: NULL). Unique read UUIDs. NULL selects by row range.

calibrated

logical (default: FALSE). Return signal in picoampers instead of ADC counts.

start_sample

numeric (default: 1). First signal sample, one-based and inclusive.

end_sample

numeric (default: Inf). Last signal sample, one-based and inclusive.

Value

list of signal vectors named by read UUID in requested order.

See also

read_pod5 for coordinate and calibration details.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
read_ids <- pod5R::read_pod5_ids("reads.pod5")
signals <- pod5R::extract_pod5_signal("reads.pod5", read_ids[1],
start_sample = 101, end_sample = 500)
} # }
